title: Masarautar da ƙarshen mai mulki ya ɓace ba a gani ba
intro: Tarihi ya san sarakuna na kowane iri, amma kaɗan ne suka mallaki wani yanki kamar wannan. Inda iska da kanta ta amsa umarninsu kuma ma'aikata da idonsu bai iya gani ba suka yi aiki cikin shiru, wannan mulkin ya yi kama da na baya ko na baya. Duk da haka har ma da manyan masarautu dole ne su ƙare - kuma lokacin da wannan ya yi, gaskiya ta fito daga tushe mai tawali'u har babu wanda ya yi tunanin zai yi zargin hakan.
clues: Ubangijina ya ba ni mulki mai girma, wanda aka yi magana a kansa a cikin shafuka masu tsarki.
Na gaji babbar hikima da iko daga iyaye waɗanda suka yi tafiya a gabana cikin ibada.
Na umurci iska, kuma ta yi tafiya mai nisa don dalilai na.
Halittu waɗanda ba a gani ga idanun talakawa sun yi aiki a ƙarƙashin ikona, suna gina abubuwan al'ajabi marasa misaltuwa.
Maɓuɓɓugan tagulla na narkakken ruwa sun kwarara a gare ni, albarka ce ta musamman a tsakanin waɗanda Allah ya zaɓa.
Lokacin da na bar wannan duniyar, jikina ya tsaya cak a kan sanda. Sai lokacin da wani ƙaramin halitta na duniya ya ci ta cikin wannan sandar ne waɗanda ke kewaye da ni suka fahimci na wuce.

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
